content:
NO ABNORMALITY DETECTED

ish 22q11.21(TUPLE1x2),22q13(ARSAx2)

In situ hybridization with probes TUPLE1 (within band 22q11.2) and ARSA (within band 22q13) did not

detect a deletion in the long arm of chromosome 22. (Deletions in the terminal region of the

chromosome 22 long arm are associated with hypotonia and developmental delay.)

This does not exclude the possibility of other mutations in these regions.
